externalId.description: The repository's id on the provider.

defaultBranch.description: The project's policy uses `dev`, `qa`, and `main` as permanent branches.

origin.description: `created` = Brabo created the repository; `adopted` = it pointed to one that already existed. Immutable once recorded (RN-046).

plan.description: The DRY-RUN: nothing was executed on the repository. Decide via `POST .../bootstrap/plan/approve` or `.../plan/skip`.

steps.description: What the bootstrap WOULD DO. An empty list = the repository is already how the template wants it, and there is nothing to approve.

actionType.description: The same taxonomy as `proposed_actions` — each approved step becomes a recorded action when the bootstrap runs.

payload.description: The mutation data: which branch, which file, from where.

diagnostics.description: The divergences between the repository and the template.

kind.description: `extra_branch` is INFORMATIONAL and never blocks: an adopted repository has whatever policy it has, and the bootstrap doesn't delete it.

alreadyAdopted.description: `true` when the project had already adopted THIS repository — nothing was created, the plan was just regenerated over the current state.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

403.description: The repository exists, but the registered credential can't reach it.

404.description: The repository doesn't exist on the provider — check the identifier.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
